# Oanda — How to import trades from Oanda into TradeZella using the file upload method?

Source: https://help.tradezella.com/en/articles/10002948-oanda-how-to-import-trades-from-oanda-into-tradezella-using-the-file-upload-method

Ready to keep your trading journal up-to-date? Here’s a simple step-by-step guide to help you seamlessly import your trades from Oanda into TradeZella.



## Exporting trade data from Oanda into a file

- Log in to your Oanda web trading platform.

Log in to your Oanda web trading platform.

- From the menu, click on Transaction History.

From the menu, click on Transaction History.

- Select the trading account you want to export trades for.

Select the trading account you want to export trades for.

- Choose the start and end dates for the trades you want to export and click on the "Show Transactions" button.

Choose the start and end dates for the trades you want to export and click on the "Show Transactions" button.

- Hit the Export to CSV button to download your trade data file.

Hit the Export to CSV button to download your trade data file.





## Uploading the exported file into TradeZella

- Visit the TradeZella Add Trade page here or by clicking the “Add Trade” button on the sidebar.

Visit the TradeZella Add Trade page here or by clicking the “Add Trade” button on the sidebar.

- On the Add Trade page, click “Add New Account” if you’re creating a new account for these trades.

On the Add Trade page, click “Add New Account” if you’re creating a new account for these trades.

If you’re uploading trades to an existing account, simply click on the “Add Trades” button in the account field:

- On the Add New Account page, select Oanda as the broker and click Continue.

On the Add New Account page, select Oanda as the broker and click Continue.

- Next, select the File Upload method and click Continue again.

Next, select the File Upload method and click Continue again.

- On the final step, select the timezone of the file and upload the file. The system will handle the rest.

On the final step, select the timezone of the file and upload the file. The system will handle the rest.



And that’s it! Your trades will be uploaded and ready for review in no time.



A sample file with some data is attached for your reference.
